project.description: 05Shaibaan | Stage 3: Release rehearsal. Parameterized simulation only; successful calculator builds use defaults.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/sh set -eu case "$TARGET_ENV" in dev|staging|prod) ;; *) echo 'Unsupported target environment' >&2; exit 2;; esac printf '
[05Shaibaan release simulation]
' printf 'Release: %s | Target: %s | Smoke checks: %s
' "$RELEASE_VERSION" "$TARGET_ENV" "$RUN_SMOKE_TESTS" if [ "$TARGET_ENV" = prod ]; then echo 'Production safety banner: simulation only.'; fi echo "Preparing the $TARGET_ENV release slot (no remote changes)..." sleep 1 echo "Release $RELEASE_VERSION staged in $TARGET_ENV (simulation)." if [ "$RUN_SMOKE_TESTS" = true ]; then echo 'Smoke checks: signed addition and subtraction endpoints (simulated).' sleep 1 echo 'Smoke checks: PASS (simulation).' else echo 'Smoke checks: skipped by parameter.' fi echo 'Release simulation completed.'
